text: だいのじの　ほのおを　あいてに　はっしゃして　こうげきする。
note: A fire shaped like the character 大 ("big") recalls Kyoto's Daimonji bonfire, a giant 大 lit on a mountainside every 16 August to send off the spirits of the dead. The English description drops the shape and just says "an intense flame".
claim: In Kyoto's Gozan no Okuribi festival on 16 August, a giant bonfire in the shape of the character 大 is lit on a mountainside.

check.quote: It is the culmination of the Obon festival on August 16 ... Daimonji (大文字), the character meaning 'large' or 'great'
